jessica: Heads-up — Planned maintenance for dedicated-gpu-pool-7
jessica: Window: 2026-03-18 01:00-02:30 UTC (90m)
jessica: Impact: We'll be cycling 4 nodes to apply kernel/security updates. Expected effects:
- short (<5s) connection resets for live RPCs being served from those nodes
- brief latency spikes for requests that hit cold KV/cache while rewarm completes
- no database migrations; no data loss expected
jessica: Customers on Dedicated in eu-west1 (capacity-reservation IDs: CR-42*, CR-43*) may observe brief degraded tail latency. We will enable model-fallback routing during the window.
jessica: Action items:
- @raj please take oncall lead & monitor pager channel
- @tom coordinate node drain steps and validate autoscaler
- @maria please prepare customer notification for the affected customers (we'll send targeted emails 24h and 1h before)
- schedule status page maintenance update (ops-bot will do once approved)
jessica: Pager rules: only page if >5% 5xx across the pool for >5m or sustained token-failures in the KV cache. Otherwise we run as maintenance with alerting only to #eng-oncall.
jessica: Runbook: internal/runbooks/dedicated-drain (see prep checklist + rollback steps)
raj: Ack. I'll be oncall for the window and will stay reachable. Who's primary for rollback? @tom?
tom: I'll be primary for the drain and rollback. Quick notes:
- we'll cordon -> drain -> patch -> uncordon
- we have warm pool enabled; if rewarm lag is >2m we'll spin temporary burst nodes and route traffic there
tom: Example commands I'll run (k8s nodes are labelled gpu:dedicated-pool-7):
```
kubectl get nodes -l pool=dedicated-pool-7
kubectl cordon <node-name>
kubectl drain <node-name> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
# patch image/upgrade kernel via ansible/patch job
kubectl uncordon <node-name>
```
tom: Will coordinate with infra to limit parallel drains to 1 node at a time (to keep capacity stable).
ops-bot: scheduled maintenance created on status.redwood.example — Maintenance ID MNT-20260318-07
statuspage-bot: public status page draft posted (scheduled). Preview: https://status.redwood.example/maintenance/MNT-20260318-07
maria: Can you drop a short customer template? I'll send 24h and 1h notices to committed customers.
jessica: Customer email template (paste and adjust):
```
Subject: Planned maintenance for Dedicated GPU pool (eu-west1) — 2026-03-18
Hi <CustomerName>,
We will perform planned maintenance on our Dedicated GPU pool in eu-west1 on 2026-03-18 01:00-02:30 UTC. This is to apply security and stability updates. You may see brief increases in tail latency and short-lived connection resets (typically <5s). No data loss is expected.
If you have pinned reserved capacity, traffic will be routed to warm nodes where possible. If you expect critical workloads during that window that cannot tolerate disruption, please reply and we will schedule a migration.
Regards,
Redwood Inference Support
```
emily: tagging list of committed customers who need direct PM outreach: cust-acme, cust-horizon, cust-trade. I'll coordinate with account teams.
raj: One ask: during the drain, please keep model-routing fallback enabled to the quantized-variant for low-latency calls. That reduces token cost and avoids cold LM starts.
jessica: Agreed — tom, can you flip fallback policy on start and off at completion? There's an API call:
```
redwoodctl routing set-fallback --pool dedicated-pool-7 --variant quantized-small --enable
```
jessica: Also note: Pager thresholds are muted for expected maintenance. We'll still get slack-only alerts; paging escalation remains if 5xx >5% for >5m.
raj: Got it. I'll be monitoring sLO and will alert if thresholds cross.
incident-bot: Pager suppressed for scheduled maintenance window (MNT-20260318-07). Exceptions still escalate.
jessica: Starting the drain now — kicking off node1 cordon/drain. I'll post updates every 15m or on any deviation.
tom: node1 drained and patched, uncordoned. node2 cordon in progress.
ops-bot: Status page: Maintenance MNT-20260318-07 is now IN PROGRESS
jessica: node2 patched and uncordoned. node3 in progress.
raj: Observed small spike in tail latency at start (~300ms extra p99) — rewarm is settling. No 5xx.
maria: Customer notifications sent to committed list (24h + 1h followups scheduled). Support inbox is primed.
jessica: node3 and node4 drained and returned. Verifying cluster health and running smoke tests.
jessica: Smoke tests: generation, embeddings, and KV-backed chat flows passed at normal rates. No elevated 5xx.

raj: Thanks team. I'll hand back oncall at shift change in 30m. All green.
